name: Klaus-Dieter Ziegler
bio:
Klaus-Dieter Ziegler brings a wealth of experience to MP Motorsport Junior, forged over two decades in high-security environments. After serving in the Bundeswehr's elite KSK unit, Klaus-Dieter transitioned his skills to the private sector, working security for high-profile corporate events and VIP protection details. His entry into motorsport was sparked by a chance encounter with a team owner who recognized the need for enhanced security measures in the paddock.

Klaus-Dieter's approach to security is proactive and detail-oriented. He believes in thorough risk assessment and preventative measures, preferring to anticipate threats before they materialize. A firm believer in teamwork, he excels at coordinating security personnel and fostering a culture of vigilance. Klaus-Dieter's military background and meticulous nature make him a uniquely effective security chief, able to maintain order and ensure the safety of the team and its assets, even in the chaotic atmosphere of a race weekend.

physical.description: A powerfully built man with a stern gaze that commands respect.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, meticulously documenting everything.
Has a habit of speaking in military jargon, even in casual conversation.
Insists on conducting regular security drills, much to the team's amusement.
